targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS questions FROM feedback GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT (sum(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(count(*),0) * 100) AS satisfaction FROM feedback
SELECT avg(latency_ms) AS latency FROM feedback
SELECT retrieval_mode, count(*) AS total FROM feedback GROUP BY retrieval_mode

panels.title: Positive vs negative feedback by mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT retrieval_mode, sum(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive, sum(CASE WHEN rating = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative FROM feedback GROUP BY retrieval_mode
SELECT study_type, count(*) AS total FROM papers GROUP BY study_type

SELECT 'embedding' AS stage, avg(embedding_ms) AS avg_ms FROM retrieval_log WHERE is_error = false UNION ALL SELECT 'search', avg(search_ms) FROM retrieval_log WHERE is_error = false UNION ALL SELECT 'rerank', avg(rerank_ms) FROM retrieval_log WHERE is_error = false AND reranked = true UNION ALL SELECT 'generation', avg(generation_ms) FROM retrieval_log WHERE is_error = false
SELECT (sum(CASE WHEN is_error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(count(*),0) * 100) AS error_rate FROM retrieval_log

SELECT 'prompt (in)' AS token_type, avg(prompt_tokens) AS avg_tokens FROM retrieval_log WHERE is_error = false UNION ALL SELECT 'completion (out)', avg(completion_tokens) FROM retrieval_log WHERE is_error = false

panels.title: Avg publication year of retrieved chunks

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(p.year) AS avg_year FROM retrieval_log r, unnest(r.paper_ids) AS pid JOIN papers p ON p.paper_id = pid WHERE r.is_error = false
SELECT count(*) AS never_retrieved FROM papers p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_log r WHERE p.paper_id = ANY(r.paper_ids))
SELECT (sum(CASE WHEN is_declined THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(sum(CASE WHEN is_declined IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) * 100) AS decline_rate FROM retrieval_log
SELECT (sum(CASE WHEN is_well_formatted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(sum(CASE WHEN is_well_formatted IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) * 100) AS well_formatted_rate FROM retrieval_log

panels.title: Avg chunk similarity score by mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, retrieval_mode, avg(avg_chunk_score) AS avg_score FROM retrieval_log WHERE avg_chunk_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Not comparable across modes: vector = cosine similarity (0-1), bm25 = unbounded lexical score, hybrid = RRF score (~0.01-0.03 range). Watch each mode's own trend, not the absolute values between modes.

panels.title: Zero-result query rate (%)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sum(CASE WHEN chunk_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(count(*),0) * 100) AS zero_result_rate FROM retrieval_log

panels.description: "No relevant chunk" defined as zero results returned, not a similarity threshold: vector/bm25/hybrid scores aren't on a comparable 0-1 scale, so one fixed threshold across modes would be meaningless.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT pid) AS distinct_papers FROM retrieval_log r, unnest(r.paper_ids) AS pid WHERE r.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Top 10 most-retrieved papers

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.title, count(*) AS times_retrieved FROM retrieval_log r, unnest(r.paper_ids) AS pid JOIN papers p ON p.paper_id = pid GROUP BY p.title ORDER BY times_retrieved DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: If the same handful of papers always come back, that's a signal to check indexing coverage or query bias — not necessarily a problem on a small corpus.
